name: Certimate
description: Gets SSL certificates and puts them where they are needed, on its own

paths.name: Pb_Data
paths.description: Certimate's database with your certificates, workflows and provider keys, and the first admin password (.admin_password). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Certimate web UI and API, published on host as 6784

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CERTIMATE_ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: The email you sign in with. Only used when the first admin is made.

variables.name: CERTIMATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first admin's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used when the first admin is made.
